title: The present value of ten £1,000 payments
caption: Each payment is worth 1000 × 1.05^−t today, so later payments count for less: £952 for the first down to £614 for the tenth. The ten bars add up to about £7,722.
alt: Ten bars falling from about 952 to 614, one for the present value of each year-end payment.
description: The payment at the end of year t is worth 1000 × 1.05^−t now.
These fall from £952 in year 1 to £614 in year 10.

checks.name: the ten present values add to 1000 × a₁₀ ≈ £7,722
